description: This file defines the PackageManagerComm class, which manages communication with the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM depot via SOAP, including login, logout, fetching packages, downloads, and documentation.

classes.name: PackageManagerComm
classes.description: Handles SOAP communication with SugarCRM's package depot, including authentication, package retrieval, download, and documentation.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the SOAP client and optionally logs in

methods.name: errorCheck
methods.description: Checks for SOAP errors in the $GLOBALS['SugarDepot'] response

methods.name: setCredentials
methods.description: Sets user credentials in the session

methods.name: clearSession
methods.description: Clears the session ID for re-authentication

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login to the depot, establishing a session

methods.name: getCategoryPackages
methods.description: Retrieves packages within a category, filtered if provided

methods.name: getReleases
methods.description: Retrieves releases associated with a package

methods.name: addDownload
methods.description: Adds a release to the download queue and returns the filename

methods.name: performDownload
methods.description: Uses curl to download a specified file from the depot

methods.name: getDocumentation
methods.description: Retrieves documentation for a package or release

methods.name: getTermsAndConditions
methods.description: Retrieves terms and conditions from the depot

methods.name: downloadedDocumentation
methods.description: Logs that a user clicked on a document

methods.name: checkForUpdates
methods.description: Sends installed object info to check for updates

methods.name: isAlive
methods.description: Pings the server to verify communication
